findings.evidence: review/complex_unlock_vault/E1.json directSites (VaultAdapter.java:38,58; NativeComplexSpecs.java:43); port/AchieveToDo-Purpur-26.2/src/main/java/com/diskree/achievetodo/gameplay/nativeguard/NativeComplexSpecs.java:44 and NativeComplexAgent.java:178-184; core/AchieveToDoPlugin.java:52-61,89
findings.description: E1 maps unlock_vault to VaultAdapter.java (a Bukkit listener never registered in CERTIFICATION mode) and to the vault-key spec NativeComplexSpecs.java:43 (tryInsertKey, would show an overlay). The guard that actually produced every locked denial is the silent eligibility filter 'vault-membership' (NativeComplexSpecs.java:44 -> NativeComplexAgent.eligible/vaultEligibilityDenied, 'SILENT:UNLOCK_VAULT'), which keeps the vault inactive for a locked player: excerpts show the main-hand interaction falling through to OFF_HAND with Item.use -> Pass and no overlay. That site is missing from E1. It matches the Fabric original (repo/src/main/java/com/diskree/achievetodo/injection/mixin/main/VaultSharedDataMixin.java), so PASS_NO_OVERLAY is parity, but the map is inaccurate and the overlay-producing key-insertion guard (spec:43) is not exercised by any row (it needs the vault activated by another, unlocked player).
